sections.title: What the App Does
paragraphs: The App is an astronomy tool. It shows a 3D sky view, real-time positions of solar system objects, and Earth maps in multiple projections with day/night cycles. Flat Earth Pro also provides weather data. The App is for educational and informational use only.

sections.title: Purpose and Neutrality
paragraphs: The App is an educational tool. Its name, maps, and visualizations are not intended to promote, prove, or disprove any scientific, political, religious, or personal belief, and nothing in the App should be taken as a statement of such a position.

sections.title: Free and Paid Versions
paragraphs: Flat Earth is free. Flat Earth Pro is a paid app. Purchases and refunds are handled by the app store you bought it from (Google Play or Apple App Store) under that store's policies.

sections.title: Accuracy Disclaimer
paragraphs: We work to keep calculations accurate, but we don't guarantee that astronomical, map, or weather data is error-free. Don't rely on the App for navigation, safety, emergencies, or any critical decision.

sections.title: Location and Data
items: The App may ask for your location permission to power the compass and improve astronomical calculations for where you are. You can deny permission and enter your location manually.
Your location and preferences are stored only on your device. We don't collect, share, or sell them. Uninstalling the App removes this data.
The App has no accounts, no logins, and no ads.

sections.title: Internet and Third-Party Services
paragraphs: The App works offline. When you're online, it may fetch app announcements (a simple data file; no device identifiers are sent). City search (both versions) and weather data (Pro) are provided by OpenWeather. For these features, only the search text or the latitude/longitude needed for the request is sent to OpenWeather, subject to OpenWeather's privacy policy. We're not responsible for third-party services.
